The fix is commit **a2eafa079**: "A previewed app's WebSocket opens behind Cloudflare: the agent drops the proxy's forwarding headers".

The commit title implies the cause: the proxy's forwarding headers were reaching the previewed app, and the WebSocket was refused. The fix makes the agent drop those headers. It touched `packages/agent/src/preview.ts`, `packages/core/src/preview-proxy.ts` and `packages/hub/src/preview.ts`, and added the probe spec `scripts/probe-kit/specs/preview-socket.ts`.

My memory doesn't hold the commit body, so I can't say which headers were involved or why the app refused the connection. I won't guess at that.
